run_IK_for_hand_robot: run inverse kinematics for a bimanual robot hand using MuJoCo with mocap bodies and equality constraints
run_IK_single_hand: run inverse kinematics for a single right or left hand embodiment with collision enabled
add_mocap_bodies_to_model: add mocap bodies with equality constraints to a MuJoCo MjSpec model for site mimic retargeting
get_robot_sites: get the list of robot site names for allegro, metahand, or standard hand types filtered by embodiment
run_IK_with_video: run inverse kinematics simulation and save a visualization video of the hand trajectory rollout
